sql: SELECT T2.DESCRIPTION, T2.VALUE, T2.UNITS FROM patients T1 JOIN observations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T1.first='Vincent' AND T1.last='Wyman' AND T2.DATE='2010-08-02' AND T2.DESCRIPTION='Body Height'
SELECT DISTINCT T1."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" FROM all_prevalences T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON lower(T1.ITEM)=lower(T2.DESCRIPTION) WHERE T2.CODE='64859006'

SELECT COUNT(T1.patient) FROM patients T1 JOIN medications T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Ibuprofen 200 MG Oral Tablet' AND T2.START LIKE '2016%' AND T1.ethnicity='dominican' AND strftime('%m',T2.STOP)-strftime('%m',T2.START)=1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.PATIENT FROM conditions T1 JOIN all_prevalences T2 ON lower(T2.ITEM)=lower(T1.DESCRIPTION) WHERE T2."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE"=18.8
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM immunizations T1 JOIN patients T2 ON T1.PATIENT=T2.patient WHERE T2.first='Keven' AND T2.last='Kuhn' AND T1.DESCRIPTION='DTaP'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients T1 JOIN medications T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION='Clopidogrel 75 MG Oral Tablet' AND strftime('%Y',T2.STOP)-strftime('%Y',T2.START)>10
SELECT T1."PREVALENCE RATE" FROM all_prevalences T1 JOIN conditions T2 ON lower(T1.ITEM)=lower(T2.DESCRIPTION) WHERE T2.START='2014-05-09'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DESCRIPTION='Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.PATIENT), SUM(CASE WHEN T1.ethnicity='english' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM patients T1 JOIN immunizations T2 ON T1.patient=T2.PATIENT WHERE strftime('%Y',T2.DATE)='2017'
